title: Integrated Marketing Lead, UCAN Programming & Industry
location: New York, NY, US; Remote, US
description:
About Pinterest:
 Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
 Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
 At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
 Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .
 Pinterest's Global Business Organization partners with advertisers, agencies and the wider industry to grow Pinterest's business. This role owns how Pinterest shows up with key industry associations and on the industry's biggest stages, from 3C Ventures, the IAB, the ANA and the MMA to marquee moments like CES and POSSIBLE. You'll be the connective tissue between Pinterest's leaders and the external industry across the U.S. and Canada, shaping visibility, influence and reputation across the advertising and marketing landscape.
 What you'll do:
 Serve as Pinterest's day-to-day contact for key industry associations — including 3C Ventures, the IAB, the ANA and the MMA — leading memberships and commitments, delivering against contractual obligations, and finding new ways to grow Pinterest's visibility and influence within these organizations.

title: Complaints Analyst III
description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase .
 As a Complaints Analyst on the Global Complaints team within Customer Experience, you'll investigate and resolve consumer, regulatory, and litigation support complaints to deliver fair outcomes for Coinbase customers. The Global Complaints team is responsible for handling complaints end-to-end across three units, and you'll own assigned cases from intake through resolution, ensuring every customer receives a thorough, accurate, and timely response.
 What you'll do:
 Investigate and resolve assigned complaints by gathering account data, transaction history, and customer communications, delivering accurate responses within defined SLA timelines
 Maintain complete case records in Salesforce, including investigation notes, resolution rationale, and customer correspondence, and submit cases for QC review before closure
 Escalate complex or ambiguous cases to your Supervisor or Complaints Lead with clear documentation of the issue and your initial assessment
 Flag recurring complaint patterns or potential process gaps to leadership to support continuous improvement across the team
 Participate in calibration sessions, training, and nesting requirements to stay aligned on evolving quality standards and process updates

title: Customer Experience Associate
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.
 Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.
 About the team + role
 We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.
 The Customer Experience Associate role offers a unique opportunity to build a career in financial services by supporting our users through complex financial topics. As a member of this team, you'll be the company's voice and will use exceptional empathy and product expertise to ensure our users feel understood and valued. Your job is not only to help our customers, but to help us learn as a company from each interaction, so that we can make our customers' experience using our products as seamless as possible.
 We demonstrate insane customer focus related to a range of needs from simplistic to complex through chat, email, and phone channels. This is an unlicensed role focused on providing high-touch support and guidance on our financial products and platform features.
 This role is based in our Denver, CO, and Westlake, TX offices, with In-person attendance expected 5 days per week during the 6-week onboarding period. After onboarding in-person attendance is expected at least 3 days a week.

 Provide an exceptional experience for customers through phone, email, and chat channels, helping them navigate financial topics and platform tools.

title: Managing Consultant (m/w/d) Power BI, Customer Success mit Entscheidungsbefugnis
description:
Über uns Die Weiler Consult GmbH ist eine Power-BI-Boutique für den deutschen Mittelstand und das Konzernumfeld. Rund 10 Power-BI-Expertinnen und -Experten bauen Reporting, das Geschäftsführer und CFOs wirklich nutzen. Unser Prinzip: Wir sind der Sherpa. Wir arbeiten remote-first, deutschlandweit, und treffen uns dreimal im Jahr zur Workation.
 Worum es geht Du bist die feste Ansprechperson für deine Kunden, vom Kickoff bis zur Verlängerung. Du machst sichtbar, was unsere Power-BI-Arbeit in den Zahlen des Kunden verändert, und steuerst die Umsetzung mit Entwicklern und Freelancern. In deiner Verantwortung liegen rund 10 bis 12 Kunden.
 Deine Aufgaben Du führst die Kundenbeziehungen, kennst Ziele und Kennzahlen deiner Kunden und hältst ihr Feedback in ClickUp fest.
 Du benennst die Veränderung in den Zahlen des Kunden, nicht die gelieferten Dashboards.
 Mit jedem Kunden führst du pro Quartal ein Strategie- und Roadmap-Gespräch: Zufriedenheit, Erfolge, Zielbild für zwei Jahre, Roadmap.
 Verlängerungen gehst du aktiv und rechtzeitig vor Vertragsende an.
 Aus der Roadmap entwickelst du Folgeprojekte.
 In der Umsetzung schneidest und priorisierst du Aufgaben in ClickUp, hältst Termine und koordinierst Entwickler und Freelancer. Du führst die Power-BI-Entwickler fachlich.
 Bei Unzufriedenheit, Budgetrisiko oder drohender Abwanderung eskalierst du früh.
 Das bringst du mit Du führst Kundengespräche selbstständig.
 Du verstehst betriebswirtschaftliche Zahlen und sprichst mit einem CFO auf Augenhöhe.
 Du kannst Power-BI-Berichte lesen und erklären.
 Du hältst Termine zuverlässig.
 Idealerweise hast du Grundlagen in DAX und Datenmodellierung oder Beratungserfahrung.
 Eher nichts für dich, wenn du Vertriebsgespräche meidest,
 lieber selbst entwickelst,
 über Dashboards statt Ergebnisse sprechen willst,
 Probleme aussitzt.

title: Senior Program Manager I
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
 About the Operations team
 The Operations team delivers seamless customer experiences and enables new product capabilities while ensuring operational excellence. The team owns strategy, planning, technical execution, customer service, fraud operations, process design, quality, training, and program management. We drive efficiency, resolve issues quickly, and scale operations as the business grows. Our goal is to deliver seamless support while maintaining high standards and reducing risk.
 About the role
 Affirm’s mission is to deliver honest financial products to improve lives. We do this by partnering with top companies to offer responsible financial products at the point of sale. Working jointly with our clients, Affirm co-develops and executes on joint partnership strategies to innovate and grow the business.
We are seeking a Partner Manager to lead performance and transformation across our global BPO vendor network. This role is accountable for driving vendor excellence and customer satisfaction at scale, while also shaping long-term vendor strategy and leading large cross-functional initiatives. The ideal candidate will bring both vendor/BPO management expertise, and the analytical capability to validate, interpret, and act on data, enabling better decisions and driving change at scale.
 This is a senior leadership role within Operations, with direct accountability for outcomes across multiple functional areas, across customer needs and requiring significant strategic oversight, cross-functional leadership, and sharp analytical judgement.

 Own vendor performance, including customer experience, service-levels, compliance, and QA outcomes.
